figures.caption: Every valid primary/additional-seed TCP trace; fixed physical boxes are drawn from the matched snapshot. No planned Cartesian path is invented. Curves are sampled TCP motion, not whole-arm swept clearance.
First available recorded route in deterministic scene/seed order (prefer obstructed scenes). All seven RRT joint configurations are preserved; the axis is geometric joint-space arc length, not time.
Generated plan samples and actual q from the same attempt. Time uses measured simulation timestamps, not rendered update count; traces are neither retimed nor projected to hide tracking error.

Movable-arm clearance excludes the mounted base in this panel; all-link/base minima remain in JSON. Reported points and physical-contact steps have distinct definitions. Missing counts are annotated as unavailable in the compact table.

Recorded whole-request, planning-and-validation, execution and RRT-call wall durations; direct/reactive request durations include their controller work and global request durations also include preplanning. Missing values are absent, not zero estimates. Worst Kit interval captures owner-loop responsiveness and is not a planning deadline guarantee.

selection: All valid primary and additional-seed attempts in TCP/contact/timing panels; lifecycle/witness/pilot and invalid attempts remain in compact JSON. One deterministic available route in joint panels.
limitations: Figures use recorded raw artifacts bound by SHA256. No new native execution, collision query, IK, FK, or timing benchmark is performed.
